On the address

Palm Jumeirah fronds are numbered plot by plot, so a villa number is an exact address. Publishing one puts the owner on the map for anyone who reads the page.

This brochure gives the frond and stops there. The plot number, the title deed reference and the owner's identity stay on the desk record and out of every client-facing document. A buyer gets the address when there is a reason to have it.

Before this becomes a brochure

  • Enter the specification — villa type, plot and built-up area, bedrooms, bathrooms, orientation, pool and beach frontage.
  • Enter the price and say whose figure it is: an owner's asking price and an agent's guide are different things and should never read the same.
  • Establish tenure from the title deed. Palm Jumeirah is a designated freehold area, but that is a statement about the area, not proof of what this particular deed says. Read it.
  • Get the service charge per square foot and the current year's statement, plus any outstanding balance on the plot.
  • Review the photography for subject and for identifiable people, and check no frame shows the villa number, a gate plate, or a neighbouring plate.
  • Confirm the instruction — who holds it, on what terms, and whether it is exclusive.
